contentHtml:
Biscoff butter cookies feel like a sweet hug in every bite, blending creamy cookie butter with a touch of golden syrup for the perfect mix of soft centers and just right crunch. Whip Biscoff spread into butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then add vanilla and a pinch of salt for extra warmth. Scoop the dough straight onto the tray and bake until your kitchen smells like caramelized heaven. Perfect for dunking in coffee or enjoying as a cozy treat, these cookies disappear fast and leave nothing but smiles.

Why You’ll Love This Biscoff butter cookies

  • Irresistibly soft and crunchy texture that melts in your mouth.
  • Rich, caramelized flavor from the iconic Biscoff spread.
  • Easy to make with simple ingredients you probably have at home.
  • Perfect for sharing or enjoying with your favorite cup of coffee.
  • A delightful treat that brings a touch of warmth to any occasion.

Biscoff butter cookies

Indulge in these easy Biscoff butter cookies! Soft, crunchy, and irresistibly delicious, they’re perfect for any occasion. 🍪✨
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 15 minutes mins
Cook Time 12 minutes mins
cooling 5 minutes mins
Total Time 32 minutes mins
Servings: 24 servings
Course: Dessert
Cuisine: American
Calories: 150
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Wet Ingredients
  • 1 cup unsalted butter softened
  • 1 cup Biscoff cookie butter for that signature flavor
  • ¾ cup granulated sugar for sweetness
  • ¼ cup brown sugar adds moisture and depth
  • 1 large egg binds the ingredients together
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract enhances the flavor
Dry Ingredients
  • 2¼ cups all-purpose flour for the dough
  • 1 tsp baking powder helps cookies rise
  • ½ tsp salt balances sweetness
  • ½ cup crushed Biscoff cookies for added texture

Equipment

  • 1 Baking sheet Lined with parchment paper
  • 1 Mixing bowl For creaming ingredients
  • 1 whisk For mixing dry ingredients

Method
 

Preparation Steps
  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). This ensures your cookies bake evenly and come out perfectly golden.
  2. In a bowl, cream together the butter, Biscoff cookie butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy. This step is key for a soft texture!
  3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until well combined. The vanilla adds a lovely aroma to your cookies.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. This helps to evenly distribute the leavening agent.
  5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mixing until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; we want those cookies to be tender!
  6. Gently fold in the crushed Biscoff cookies. This adds delightful bits of crunch and flavor to each bite.
  7. Scoop the dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, spacing them about 2 inches apart. This gives them room to spread while baking.
  8. Gently flatten each cookie with the palm of your hand or a fork. This helps them bake evenly and gives a nice shape.
  9. Bake for 10–12 minutes or until the edges are golden. Your kitchen will smell amazing!
  10. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. Then, enjoy your delicious Biscoff butter cookies!

How to Make Biscoff Butter Cookies

Get ready to bake some delightful Biscoff butter cookies! With a preparation time of 15 minutes and a cooking time of 10–12 minutes, these cookies are perfect for any occasion. Allow an extra 5 minutes for cooling before indulging in their soft and crunchy goodness.

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). This ensures your cookies bake evenly and come out perfectly golden.

Step 2: Cream the Ingredients

In a bowl, cream together the butter, Biscoff cookie butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy. This step is key for a soft texture!

Step 3: Add Egg and Vanilla

Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until well combined. The vanilla adds a lovely aroma to your cookies.

Step 4: Mix Dry Ingredients

In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. This helps to evenly distribute the leavening agent.

Step 5: Combine Wet and Dry Ingredients

Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mixing until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; we want those cookies to be tender!

Step 6: Fold in Biscoff Cookies

Gently fold in the crushed Biscoff cookies. This adds delightful bits of crunch and flavor to each bite.

Step 7: Scoop the Dough

Scoop the dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, spacing them about 2 inches apart. This gives them room to spread while baking.

Step 8: Flatten the Cookies

Gently flatten each cookie with the palm of your hand or a fork. This helps them bake evenly and gives a nice shape.

Step 9: Bake the Cookies

Bake for 10–12 minutes or until the edges are golden. Your kitchen will smell amazing!

Step 10: Cool and Enjoy

Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. Then, enjoy your delicious Biscoff butter cookies!

Pro Tips for Making Biscoff butter cookies

  • Chill the dough for 30 minutes for a better texture.
  • Use a cookie scoop for uniform sizes and even baking.
  • Experiment with different add-ins like chocolate chips or nuts.
  • Don’t overbake; they should be soft in the center.

How to Serve this Biscoff butter cookies

  • Enjoy them with a cup of hot chocolate for a cozy treat.
  • Pair with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for a delightful dessert.
  • Serve alongside a fresh fruit platter for a refreshing contrast.
  • Crush them and sprinkle over yogurt or oatmeal for added crunch.

Make Ahead and Storage

Keep your Biscoff butter cookies fresh and delicious with these simple storage tips:

Storing Biscoff Butter Cookies Leftovers

  • Allow cookies to cool completely before storing.
  • Place in an airtight container to maintain freshness.
  • Store at room temperature for up to one week.
  • For longer storage, consider refrigeration.

Freezing Biscoff Butter Cookies

  • Wrap cookies individually in plastic wrap.
  • Place wrapped cookies in a freezer-safe bag or container.
  • Label with the date for easy tracking.
  • Freeze for up to three months for best quality.

Reheating Biscoff Butter Cookies

  • Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
  • Place cookies on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
  • Heat for about 5-7 minutes until warm.
  • Enjoy the soft and crunchy texture just like fresh!

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. What is the flavor of Biscoff cookie butter?

Biscoff cookie butter has a unique flavor that combines the warm, spiced notes of caramelized biscuits with a creamy texture. It’s sweet, slightly nutty, and has hints of cinnamon and brown sugar, making it a delightful spread for cookies, toast, or even straight from the jar!

2. What is so special about Biscoff cookies?

Biscoff cookies are special because they are made with a unique blend of spices and have a distinct caramelized flavor. They are crunchy, perfectly balanced in sweetness, and are often enjoyed with coffee or tea. Their unique taste and texture have made them a favorite treat around the world!

3. What do you do with Biscoff cookie butter?

Biscoff cookie butter is incredibly versatile! You can spread it on toast, pancakes, or waffles, use it as a filling for cookies or cakes, or even swirl it into yogurt or oatmeal. It also makes a delicious dip for fruits or pretzels, and can be used in various dessert recipes for added flavor!

4. What is the actual flavour of Biscoff?

The actual flavor of Biscoff is a delightful combination of caramel, brown sugar, and a hint of spice, primarily cinnamon. This unique blend gives Biscoff cookies their signature taste, which is both sweet and slightly savory, making them a perfect companion for coffee or as a standalone snack!

Final Thoughts

Get ready to indulge in the delightful world of Biscoff butter cookies! With their soft centers and crunchy edges, these treats are a breeze to whip up. So gather your ingredients, channel your inner baker, and enjoy the sweet aroma filling your kitchen. Trust me, every bite will take you back to cozy moments—happy baking!
